searchResults.resultTitle: Bluebird Bakery — bread, pastry and coffee in Lincoln Square
searchResults.resultSnippet: One small bakery and coffee counter in north Chicago, open Wednesday to Sunday until the case is empty. There is one Bluebird. Bluebird is Hannah and Pete Kowalski.
Whole cakes with seven days' notice and up to ten loaves with three days' notice. To order a cake, call us or stop by the counter.
Owned and run by two people, Hannah Kowalski and Pete Kowalski. We have had one location since 2016, and we intend to keep it that way.
We do not take orders online. There is no order form on this site, no shopping cart, no app, and we are not listed on any delivery service.

searchResults.resultTitle: Bluebird Bakery — bread, pastry and coffee in Lincoln Square
searchResults.resultSnippet: Whole cakes and big bread orders: it starts with a conversation with one of us, not with a form. Phone 312-555-0106 during shop hours.
